Local Buyer & Seller Q&A
What types of homes are for sale in Cottonwood, Maple Ridge?

Active MLS® listings in Cottonwood typically include family detached homes on suburban subdivisions (median 5,995 sq ft lot size in Q3 2026), multi-family townhome complexes, and apartment condos between 232 St and 240 St. In Q3 2026, Cottonwood recorded Detached median $1,199,000 ($511/sq ft, 6,011 sq ft lot) · Townhome median $799,000 ($475/sq ft) · Condo median $547,450. Every listing at the top of this page updates automatically from the Greater Vancouver Realtors (GVR) MLS® feed.
Which School District 42 schools serve Cottonwood in Maple Ridge?

Public schools serving or located near Cottonwood include Alexander Robinson Elementary (11849 239B St, K-7), Golden Ears Elementary (23124 118 Ave, K-7), Kanaka Creek Elementary (11180 234A St), and Thomas Haney Secondary (23000 116 Ave, 8-12). Always verify exact street-address catchment boundaries using the official School District 42 (Maple Ridge – Pitt Meadows) locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Cottonwood?

Residents of Cottonwood enjoy access to Thomas Haney Youth Action Park (11633 230 St), Telosky Stadium (23000 116 Ave), Cottonwood North Park (11905 Cottonwood Dr), and Kanaka Creek Regional Park. See our companion
Cottonwood Neighbourhood Guide
for full park addresses, trail networks, and community recreation details.
How are roads, West Coast Express access, and commuting in Cottonwood?

Primary commuter and road corridors serving Cottonwood include Dewdney Trunk Road, 112 Avenue, 116 Avenue, 232 Street, 240 Street, and Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7), connecting residents to Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7), Dewdney Trunk Road, the Golden Ears Bridge, and TransLink RapidBus (R3) and West Coast Express commuter rail stations.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or ALR rules apply in Cottonwood?

Cottonwood sits directly between Town Centre and Albion under Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019, featuring RS-1b and compact urban single-family lots, ground-oriented townhome developments along 232 St and 240 St, and riparian setbacks along the North and South Alouette and Kanaka Creek tributaries. What are the 2021 Statistics Canada Census demographics for Cottonwood?

According to the 2021 Statistics Canada Census (custom GVR sub-area boundary compilation), Cottonwood has a population of 11,225 across 4,080 occupied private dwellings, a median household income of $114,000, and an owner-occupancy rate of 82%.
